value_for_money.definition: Is the product worth its price? Price-to-benefit perception.
value_for_money.low_score_meaning: Poor price-to-benefit ratio; overpriced relative to features and market alternatives
value_for_money.high_score_meaning: Exceptional value proposition; delivers flagship-grade capabilities at accessible price
value_for_money.null_behavior_in_extraction: null when review does not mention price, cost, or worth
value_for_money.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Adjusted deterministically from launch price relative to category price distribution

utility.definition: Does the product perform its core function well? (e.g., sound quality for headphones)
utility.low_score_meaning: Fails at core functional purpose; weak fundamental performance
utility.high_score_meaning: Superb primary performance (e.g. pristine acoustic reproduction, rapid ice production)
utility.null_behavior_in_extraction: null when review omits functional performance
utility.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires concrete spec attributes (e.g. driver size, transducer specs, ice production lb/day)

ease_of_use.low_score_meaning: Convoluted setup, unintuitive controls, painful pairing or ergonomics
ease_of_use.high_score_meaning: Effortless plug-and-play, seamless connectivity, intuitive user interface
ease_of_use.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires physical button specs, app pairing protocol, or companion software details

reliability.definition: Consistent performance over time; no malfunctions or connectivity drops.
reliability.low_score_meaning: Frequent hardware dropouts, firmware glitches, sporadic operational failures
reliability.high_score_meaning: Rock-solid continuous operation without connectivity drops or software crashes
reliability.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Anchored to category prior unless spec specifies enterprise-grade controllers or Bluetooth 5.2+

design_appeal.definition: Aesthetics, look and feel, form factor.
design_appeal.low_score_meaning: Clunky, cheap aesthetics, awkward form factor, outdated visual styling
design_appeal.high_score_meaning: Sleek, premium industrial design, modern minimalist aesthetics, refined finish
design_appeal.null_behavior_in_extraction: null when review omits visual/form comments
design_appeal.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires specific materials or styling dimensions; low-weight aspect in confidence

after_sales.low_score_meaning: Unresponsive customer service, rejected warranty claims, zero spare parts
after_sales.high_score_meaning: Prompt, courteous support, hassle-free replacement, multi-year warranty
after_sales.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Unestimable from standard specs; scored at category average with grounded=False (weight ~0)

build_quality.definition: Materials, construction solidity, fit and finish.
build_quality.low_score_meaning: Flimsy plastic, creaking hinges, uneven gaps, cheap construction feel
build_quality.high_score_meaning: Rigid aluminum chassis, precision tolerances, premium tactile materials
build_quality.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires explicit material declarations (anodized aluminum, reinforced silicone, etc.)

durability.definition: Longevity; resistance to wear, drops, breakage over time.
durability.low_score_meaning: Degrades within months; broken joints, frayed cables, dead battery cells
durability.high_score_meaning: Survives drops, moisture, outdoor exposure, and years of daily wear
durability.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires certified ingress protection (IP67, IPX8), drop ratings, or cycle ratings

repairability.definition: Ease of repair, spare parts, serviceability.
repairability.low_score_meaning: Glued shut, proprietary fasteners, irreplaceable battery, disposable design
repairability.high_score_meaning: Modular assembly, replaceable battery/cables, standard screws, published manuals
repairability.grounding_rule_in_bridging: Requires modular claims; ungrounded if absent
